name: Mixpeek
tagline: Find any scene in your video and multimodal library.
description: Mixpeek is a multimodal retrieval API for searching across video, images, audio, and documents with natural language. It extracts and indexes structured features — faces, scenes, transcripts, OCR, and embeddings — over object storage like S3, GCS, and R2, then runs hybrid dense, sparse, and BM25 search with reranking. Cross-modal joins let a single query combine signals such as faces, spoken phrases, and on-screen text.

modelSupport.notes: Retrieval and embedding infrastructure; not tied to a single model provider.

insight: Its vector store offers 1M vectors free with no expiration, with managed multimodal indexing billed per usage credit.
edge: One API for cross-modal retrieval over video, audio, images, and documents — joining faces, transcripts, and on-screen text in a single query.
pros: Searches video, image, audio, and docs
cons: Core platform is not open source
